move: cursor drags slider thumb across, faces swap with elastic pops, settles back
how: A white card holds a question, a large emoji face, a gradient track with a fill, thumb, tooltip and a cursor pinned to the thumb. The cursor arrives with power3.out in the first 18% of the 4s loop; the thumb grows 1.25x with back.out(3) and the tooltip fades in. From 0.85s to 1.85s a proxy value tweens 0.12 to 0.92 with power2.inOut, driving translateX of the thumb group and the fill width via onUpdate, then overshoots back to 0.86 with elastic.out(1,0.5). As the value crosses 0.3, 0.55 and 0.8 the current face drops away (yPercent -60, scale 0.7, power2.in, 0.18s) and the next rises in with rotation -15 to 0 and elastic.out(1,0.5) while the tooltip text swaps Meh / Okay / Good / Amazing. Cursor leaves at 2.7s, tooltip hides, and the value glides back to 0.12 with power3.inOut in the last 12% while the first face returns with back.out(2).
adapt: Change the question, the four faces and labels, the gradient colours and the crossing thresholds; the track width W is derived from the card width. Keep the 1s drag with power2.inOut and the elastic overshoot back.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the card, faces, track/fill/pos/thumb/tip and the cursor inside el. animate returns the same timeline with a proxy object tween ({v}) whose onUpdate writes transform and width on scoped elements; time constants become fractions of D (drag 0.21D to 0.46D, exit 0.68D, reset 0.875D). The crossT() mapping from threshold to time must use the same fractions.
caveats: the face-swap times are computed by inverting power2.inOut analytically and only match if the drag ease stays power2.inOut
tooltip text is changed with .set(textContent) which does not scrub backwards cleanly
